metadata.name: Platform Foundation & MVP Development
metadata.description: Build the core dual canvas system with Editor Panel overlay system, implement universal node architecture with 7 core node types (agent, task, workflow, artifact_template, checklist, data, artifact_class), implement natural language agent persona/role definition, and create workflow design capabilities with task input/output edges. Launch MVP with comprehensive node metadata schema within 1 week development sprint to establish the foundation for all subsequent initiatives.

metadata.name: Dual Canvas System
metadata.description: Implement a dual canvas system with Design Mode for workflow building and Execution Mode for workflow runtime monitoring. Design Mode includes left panel (Explorer), center panel (React Flow Canvas), and Editor Panel overlay system (z-index overlay for node metadata editing). Execution Mode includes left panel (Nodes), center panel (Canvas), and right panel (Interaction) with progressive node generation.

metadata.name: Universal Node System
metadata.description: Implement a Notion-inspired universal node system where everything is a node. Include 7 core system-defined nodes (agent, task, workflow, artifact_template, checklist, data, artifact_class) with hierarchical parent-child relationships. Support template-driven customization with sub-node definitions (Node Definition, Edge Definition, Column Definition) and auto-generated Artifact Class nodes.

metadata.name: Natural Language Agent Definition
metadata.description: Enable users to describe agent personas/roles, task markdown instructions, and workflows in plain English/Korean through text input fields. Automatically translate natural language descriptions into structured metadata schemas (persona_definition, role_definition, task variables) without requiring coding knowledge.

metadata.name: Progressive Node Generation
metadata.description: Implement real-time node creation with immediate visual feedback during workflow execution. Nodes should appear on canvas as they're generated according to template definitions, with progressive relationship visualization and immediate interaction capabilities.

metadata.name: Workflow Design & Configuration
metadata.description: Enable design and configuration of workflows with 2-3 agents, providing visual workflow building capabilities. Support task input/output edge design, artifact template configuration, and workflow validation with preview capabilities for workflow structure.

metadata.name: User Authentication
metadata.description: Implement basic signup/login functionality using Clerk authentication. Provide user-specific workflow and artifact storage with session management for workflow instances.

metadata.name: Drag-and-Drop Interface
metadata.description: Implement intuitive drag-and-drop functionality for placing nodes on the canvas and creating visual connections between workflow components. Support visual node-relationship connections with immediate feedback.

metadata.name: Editor Panel Overlay System
metadata.description: Implement z-index overlay editor panels that appear when clicking nodes on canvas. Provide context-aware metadata editing forms for different node types (Agent: persona/role, Task: markdown/variables, etc.) with connected nodes visualization and real-time updates.

metadata.name: Task Input/Output Edge System
metadata.description: Implement input and output edge types for task nodes enabling connections to Data, Checklist, Artifact Class, and Artifact Template nodes. Support clear data flow dependencies and artifact generation chains with validation.
